name: YahooFinanceTool
description: Fetch historical OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) price data from Yahoo Finance. Returns a dataRef that can be passed to indicator tools.

fields.label: Ticker Symbol
fields.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL for Apple, TSLA for Tesla, MSFT for Microsoft).

fields.label: Interval
fields.description: Time interval between data points. Use 1d for daily analysis, shorter intervals for intraday.

fields.label: Date Mode
fields.description: How to specify date range. Use 'lookback' (RECOMMENDED) to get most recent N bars from today. Use 'range' only for specific historical periods like backtesting.

fields.label: Bars to Fetch
fields.description: Number of bars/periods to fetch backwards from today. For example, 90 with interval '1d' gets the last 90 days of daily data.

fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: Start date for historical data range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Only used when date_mode is 'range'.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: End date for historical data range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today if not specified.
